messages.AUTH.LOGIN_FAILED: The company code, email or password is incorrect.
messages.AUTH.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: This account is temporarily locked. Try again later.
messages.AUTH.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
messages.AUTH.MFA_REQUIRED: Enter the verification code to continue.
messages.AUTH.ACCOUNT_INACTIVE: This account is not active. Contact your administrator.
messages.ERROR.UNAUTHENTICATED: You need to sign in to continue.
messages.ERROR.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
messages.ERROR.NOT_FOUND: We could not find what you asked for.
messages.ERROR.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some of the information is not valid. Please check and try again.
messages.ERROR.CONFLICT: This item was changed by someone else. Reload and try again.
messages.ERROR.INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION: This action is not allowed in the current status.
messages.ERROR.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
messages.ERROR.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
messages.SHELL.NO_NOTIFICATIONS: You have no notifications. Notifications will appear here once the notification feature is available.
messages.SHELL.HOME_EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Operational modules such as jobs, dispatch and reports arrive in later phases. Until then, use the account menu to manage your sessions and security.
messages.AUTH_UI.LOGIN_INTRO: Use your company code, email and password.
messages.AUTH_UI.NOTICE_INVITATION_ACCEPTED: Your account is ready. Sign in with your company code, email and new password.
messages.AUTH_UI.NOTICE_PASSWORD_RESET: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new password.
messages.AUTH_UI.MFA_ENROLL_INTRO: Your role requires two-step verification. Set up an authenticator app to continue.
messages.AUTH_UI.MFA_CODE_HINT: Open your authenticator app and enter the current code.
messages.AUTH_UI.MFA_CODE_INVALID: The verification code is not valid. Check the code and try again.
messages.AUTH_UI.MFA_NOT_SET_UP: Two-step verification has not been set up for this account.
messages.AUTH_UI.MFA_UNAVAILABLE: Two-step verification is not available because the server is not configured for it. Contact your administrator.
messages.AUTH_UI.PASSWORDS_DO_NOT_MATCH: The two passwords do not match.
messages.AUTH_UI.PASSWORD_POLICY: Use at least 12 characters, and not your email address.
messages.AUTH_UI.INVITATION_INTRO: Choose a password to activate your account.
messages.AUTH_UI.INVITATION_INVALID: This invitation link is invalid or has expired. Ask your administrator for a new one.
messages.AUTH_UI.RESET_INTRO: Enter a new password for your account.
messages.AUTH_UI.RESET_LINK_INVALID: This password reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
messages.AUTH_UI.FORGOT_INTRO: Enter your company code and email. If an account matches, we will send a reset link.
messages.AUTH_UI.RESET_REQUEST_SENT: If an account matches, a reset link is on its way.
messages.ACCOUNT.SESSIONS_INTRO: Places where your account is signed in. Revoke any session you do not recognize.
messages.ACCOUNT.SESSIONS_EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Sign in again to start a new session.
messages.ACCOUNT.SECURITY_INTRO: Protect your account with a second verification step.
messages.ACCOUNT.MFA_ENABLED_DESCRIPTION: An authenticator app is linked to your account. You will be asked for a code each time you sign in.
messages.ACCOUNT.MFA_SETUP_INSTRUCTIONS: You will get a secret key to add to an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, 1Password or Authy.
messages.ACCOUNT.MFA_URI_HELP: Add this key to your authenticator app. This key is shown only once and must be kept private.
